name: Birth records (Birth Statistical Master File)
owner: CDPH Center for Health Statistics and Informatics
population: Every birth in California
key_variables: Date and county of birth; Birthweight and gestational age; Prenatal care start; Principal payer (Medi-Cal or private); Parent age, education, race/ethnicity; Plurality, delivery method
legal: Health and Safety Code 102100 et seq.; CPHS review for research
c2c_note: Not a C2C partner. Birth data reaches CalKIDS, which is a C2C partner, so a narrow indirect path exists.
notes: The only universal record of every child. Linking it forward would anchor a true cradle-to-career chain.

name: Newborn Screening Program
population: Nearly all newborns
key_variables: Screening results for metabolic, genetic and endocrine conditions; Hearing screening referral; Follow-up status
legal: Health and Safety Code 124975 et seq.; HIPAA
c2c_note: Not in C2C. Relevant for Early Start referral pathways.

name: WIC (Women, Infants and Children)
population: Low-income pregnant and postpartum people, infants, and children under 5
key_variables: Enrollment and certification category; Nutrition risk; Breastfeeding status; Height/weight; Household income
c2c_note: Not in C2C. WIC participation could signal early need but is invisible to education data.

name: CalKIDS college savings accounts
population: Every child born in CA since July 1, 2022, plus low-income public school students (over 5.6 million funded accounts by April 2026)
key_variables: Account seeded (newborn or school-based); Account claimed by family; Family deposits; Funds used for postsecondary
c2c_note: Approved as a C2C data provider in February 2025 (Resolution 25-01) to study CalKIDS use and college access.
notes: Accounts are opened from CDPH birth data and CDE student data. SIB's own 2025 annual report flags those data linkages as a challenge to strengthen.

name: California Preschool Data Collection (CAPSDAC 2.0)
population: Children, classrooms and staff in LEA-operated California State Preschool Program (CSPP)
key_variables: Child enrollment and attendance; Classroom assignment; Staff and qualifications; Child demographics; Dual language learner status
c2c_note: Not yet imported to C2C. The 2026-27 C2C work plan sets initial milestones for importing early learning and care data.
notes: Required since July 2024 for LEA-run CSPP. SSID use is encouraged, not required, so many preschool records cannot be matched to later K-12 records.

name: CDE CDMIS and 801A monthly population report (CSPP)
population: Families and children in CDE-contracted CSPP (all operators, including non-LEA)
key_variables: Family size and income; Reason for need and eligibility; Child age, ethnicity, primary language; Days of enrollment; Co-enrollment in a CDSS child care program (added 2025)
legal: Education Code 8200 et seq.; Welfare and Institutions Code 10850
c2c_note: C2C planned early learning entry age, enrollment duration and family income from CDE since 2023 but had not received them.
notes: CDE announced CDMIS 2.0 in October 2026. A new CDMIS Monthly Report replaces the 801A starting with July 2027.

name: CDSS child care subsidy data (CDD-801A in CDSS CDMIS)
owner: CDSS Child Care and Development Division
population: Families in CDSS child care programs: general child care, migrant, family child care networks, alternative payment, CalWORKs Stages 2 and 3
key_variables: Family income and size; Eligibility and need; Provider type and setting; Child age and demographics; Subsidy amount and hours
legal: Welfare and Institutions Code 10207 et seq.; Welfare and Institutions Code 10850; CCDF 45 CFR 98
c2c_note: CDSS is a C2C partner for social services data, but child care records are not yet in the P20W data set.
notes: Most child care programs moved from CDE to CDSS in July 2021 (AB 131). Since October 2024 all CDSS contract-type child data goes to the CDSS CDMIS.

name: Community Care Licensing (child care facilities)
population: Every licensed child care center and family child care home
key_variables: License number and type; Licensed capacity by age group; Address and county; Inspection and citation history; Status (open, closed, on probation)
legal: Health and Safety Code 1596.70 et seq.
c2c_note: Facility-level only. Useful for supply and desert analysis, not for following children.

name: Child Care Resource and Referral data
owner: Local R&R agencies and the CA Child Care Resource & Referral Network
population: Families seeking care and licensed providers in each county
key_variables: Licensed slots by age and setting; Referral requests and unmet need; Provider vacancies; Cost of care
c2c_note: Not in C2C.

name: Head Start and Early Head Start (Program Information Report)
owner: Federal Office of Head Start (ACF); local grantees
population: Low-income pregnant people, infants, toddlers and preschoolers in federally funded programs
key_variables: Funded and cumulative enrollment; Child health insurance and medical home; Disability services; Family services; Staff qualifications
c2c_note: No state child-level data. Grantees keep records in their own systems. California's Head Start State Collaboration Office sits at CDE but holds no child records.
notes: Head Start children can enroll in TK or kindergarten with no record of their preschool experience.

name: First 5 California and county commissions
owner: First 5 California and 58 county First 5 commissions
population: Children 0 to 5 and families served by Prop 10 funded programs
key_variables: Services delivered by result area; Home visiting and family support participation; Quality improvement participation; Annual Prop 10 outcomes reporting
legal: Health and Safety Code 130100 et seq. (Prop 10)
c2c_note: Not in C2C. Each county uses its own data system.

name: Quality Counts California (QRIS)
owner: CDE, CDSS and First 5 California with county consortia
population: Participating ECE sites and educators
key_variables: Site quality tier and element ratings; Educator qualifications and training; CLASS and environment rating scores
c2c_note: Not in C2C. Site data could link to children only if child records carried a site ID and a matchable child ID.

name: Desired Results Developmental Profile (DRDP)
owner: CDE (Early Education and Special Education divisions)
population: Children in CSPP, CDSS-funded centers and preschool special education
key_variables: Developmental ratings across domains (language, literacy, math, social-emotional, physical); Assessment period; IEP status
c2c_note: Not in C2C. Special education DRDP uses SSID. General early learning DRDP mostly uses local IDs.

name: DDS Early Start and regional center services
owner: Department of Developmental Services and 21 regional centers
population: Infants and toddlers with or at risk of delays (IDEA Part C), and people with developmental disabilities
key_variables: Eligibility and diagnosis category; Early Start service receipt; Regional center; IFSP and transition at age 3; Level of support
legal: Welfare and Institutions Code 4514; IDEA Part C
c2c_note: Approved as a C2C data provider in May 2024 (Resolution 24-02). Proposed points include eligibility, enrollment and receipt of Early Start services.

name: California Home Visiting Program (MIECHV)
owner: CDPH Maternal, Child and Adolescent Health
population: Families enrolled in evidence-based home visiting in participating counties
key_variables: Enrollment and visit dosage; Developmental and depression screening; Child injury and ED visits; Benchmarks required by HRSA
c2c_note: Not in C2C.

name: CalWORKs Home Visiting Program
population: CalWORKs families who are pregnant or have a child under 24 months
key_variables: Enrollment and visit completion; Family goals; Program model
c2c_note: Not in C2C.

name: California ECE Workforce Registry
population: Early educators who create a profile (voluntary; required in some local programs)
key_variables: Employment history and site; Education and permits; Training hours; Compensation (some sites)
c2c_note: Not in C2C. Voluntary participation means the data does not represent the whole workforce.

name: California ECE Workforce Study
owner: UC Berkeley Center for the Study of Child Care Employment
population: Survey of more than 10,000 early educators (2025 round)
key_variables: Wages and benefits; Education and credentials; Demographics and languages; Turnover intent
c2c_note: Research survey, not linkable.

name: Child Development Permits
population: ECE teachers and directors holding a Child Development Permit (Associate Teacher to Program Director)
key_variables: Permit type and level; Issue and expiration dates; Coursework and units
c2c_note: CTC is a C2C partner for credential data. Whether permit records are in P20W, and whether ECE employment is captured, needs confirmation.

name: CALPADS (student and staff records)
population: About 5.8 million public TK-12 students and all school staff
key_variables: Enrollment, TK and grade level; Race/ethnicity, gender, language and EL status; Reclassification (RFEP) and State Seal of Biliteracy; Special education and 504; Socioeconomically disadvantaged, foster, homeless, migrant flags; Attendance and chronic absence; Courses, grades, A-G and CTE completion (grades 7-12); Dual enrollment courses; Graduation and dropout; Discipline
c2c_note: Core C2C data provider since the first data submissions in 2023.
linked_to: c2c; calpass; ccgi; cde_assess; cde_capsdac; cde_dircert; cde_foster; cde_public; csac; ctc_educator; dds_earlystart; sib_calkids
missing_links: cde_expanded; cdss_ccdd; drdp; first5; hdis; head_start
notes: The backbone of state education data. No field records preschool or child care history at kindergarten entry.

name: CAASPP and ELPAC assessments
population: Students in tested grades; English learners for ELPAC
key_variables: Smarter Balanced ELA and math scale scores; CAST science; ELPAC summative and initial; Alternate assessments
c2c_note: Some assessment results are part of the K-12 data CDE provides. Item-level and early-grade measures are not.

name: California School Dashboard, DataQuest and College/Career Indicator
population: Every public school, district and student group
key_variables: Dashboard indicators (academic, ELPI, graduation, chronic absence, suspension); College/Career Indicator (CCI); Enrollment and staffing downloads
c2c_note: D4TP is asking C2C to link postsecondary outcomes back to the CCI so schools see what happened to graduates.

name: Educator preparation, credentials and TAMO
population: Credential candidates, completers and credential holders; teacher assignments
key_variables: Credentials and authorizations; Preparation program and pathway; Completer surveys; Teaching Assignment Monitoring Outcomes (TAMO); Teacher supply report
c2c_note: CTC is a C2C partner. C2C is building a teacher training and retention dashboard in its 2026-27 work plan.

name: Direct Certification match (school meals)
owner: CDE Nutrition Services with CDSS and DHCS
population: Students in households enrolled in CalFresh, CalWORKs or Medi-Cal
key_variables: Matched program participation; Free or reduced-price meal eligibility; Socioeconomically disadvantaged status
legal: National School Lunch Act 42 USC 1758; Welfare and Institutions Code 10850 exceptions
c2c_note: Results flow into CALPADS socioeconomic flags, which C2C receives. The underlying CIN link is not kept.
notes: A working proof that human services and education records can be matched routinely at scale.

name: Foster youth match (CDE and CDSS)
population: Students in foster care
key_variables: Foster status; County of jurisdiction; Social worker contact (to LEAs)
legal: Education Code 49085; Welfare and Institutions Code 827
c2c_note: Foster flag appears in CALPADS data provided to C2C.

name: Expanded learning (ELO-P, ASES, 21st CCLC)
population: Students in before, after and summer school programs
key_variables: Program attendance (site level); Funding and slots; Outcome reports (federal 21st CCLC)
c2c_note: Participation is not reported by SSID, so it cannot be linked to outcomes. Raised as a TK-12 workgroup idea.

name: Private School Affidavit
population: Private schools and homeschool filers
key_variables: School name and address; Enrollment by grade (counts); Staff counts
c2c_note: No student-level data. Students who start in private school or homeschool have no SSID until they enter public school.

name: CaliforniaColleges.edu and eTranscript California
owner: California College Guidance Initiative (Foundation for CCC)
population: Students in participating districts (most public high school students)
key_variables: Student accounts and career exploration; Verified transcripts and A-G progress; Cal Grant and FAFSA/CADAA status; College applications
c2c_note: C2C's operational tools for college and career planning and electronic transcripts.

name: Cal-PASS Plus
owner: Educational Results Partnership and San Joaquin Delta College
population: Students in K-12 districts and colleges that sign data-sharing MOUs
key_variables: K-12 course and grade data; College placement and course outcomes; Regional pathway reports
c2c_note: Predates C2C. Voluntary coverage means gaps by district.

name: Community College MIS and CCCApply
population: About 2 million students a year at 116 colleges, including dual enrollment and noncredit
key_variables: Applications (CCCApply), including SSID when provided; Course enrollment and grades; Awards (degrees, certificates); Transfer-level milestones; Financial aid (Promise, Pell, Cal Grant); Dual enrollment (CCAP); EOPS, DSPS, CalWORKs, veterans; Program (TOP code)
c2c_note: Core C2C data provider.
linked_to: c2c; calpass; ccc_launchboard; csac; csu_ers; uc_ss

name: LaunchBoard, Student Success Metrics and Strong Workforce outcomes
owner: CCCCO with Cal-PASS Plus and WestEd
population: CCC students and CTE program completers
key_variables: Program completion; Employment and median earnings (EDD wage match); Living wage attainment; CTE Outcomes Survey
c2c_note: Earnings outcomes depend on SSN-based EDD matching, so students without SSNs are missing.

name: CSU enrollment and degree reporting (ERS)
population: About 460,000 students at 23 campuses
key_variables: Applications and admissions; Enrollment and units; Degrees and majors (CIP); Transfer origin; Financial aid
c2c_note: Core C2C data provider. D4TP members report FERPA interpretations limit student debt data sharing.

name: UC student data (Corporate Student System)
owner: University of California Office of the President
population: About 300,000 students at 10 campuses
key_variables: Applications and admissions; Enrollment; Degrees and majors; Transfer origin; Financial aid and debt at graduation
c2c_note: C2C data provider. Because of constitutional autonomy, statute requests rather than requires UC participation (restated in SB 135, 2026).

name: Independent nonprofit colleges (AICCU members)
owner: Association of Independent California Colleges and Universities
population: Students at participating private nonprofit institutions
key_variables: Enrollment; Degrees; Cal Grant recipients
c2c_note: Represented on the C2C Governing Board. Participation is voluntary and institution by institution.

name: Private postsecondary institutions (BPPE)
population: Students at for-profit and private vocational schools approved by BPPE
key_variables: Annual reports; Student Performance Fact Sheets (completion, placement, licensure); Complaints and enforcement
c2c_note: Listed as a C2C data partner, but BPPE collects institution-level reports, not student records, so students in these programs are largely invisible.

name: CSAC financial aid (Grant Delivery System, WebGrants)
population: FAFSA and CA Dream Act filers; Cal Grant, Middle Class Scholarship, Chafee and other awardees
key_variables: FAFSA and CADAA completion; High school GPA uploads; Cal Grant eligibility and award; Middle Class Scholarship; Payment and renewal
legal: FERPA; Education Code 69400 et seq.; Higher Education Act (FAFSA data)
c2c_note: C2C data provider. Financial aid data points added to P20W in 2024.
linked_to: c2c; ccc_mis; ccgi; cde_calpads; csu_ers; fed_fsa; uc_ss

name: Federal student aid and loans (FAFSA, NSLDS)
population: Federal aid applicants and borrowers
key_variables: FAFSA/ISIR data; Pell receipt; Federal loan balances and repayment status
c2c_note: Loan data is not available to C2C. Student debt is a priority gap for D4TP (TICAS, Public Advocates).

name: National Student Clearinghouse
population: Enrollment and degrees at most U.S. colleges, including out of state
key_variables: Enrollment by term at any participating college; Degrees; Institution type and state
c2c_note: Not in C2C, so students who leave California or attend most private colleges disappear from the state picture.

name: IPEDS and College Scorecard
population: Every Title IV institution
key_variables: Enrollment and completions by CIP; Graduation rates; Net price; Earnings after entry (Scorecard, from IRS); Debt at completion
c2c_note: Institution-level public data.

name: Adult education (CAEP, TOPSpro Enterprise)
owner: CDE and CCCCO (California Adult Education Program) with CASAS
population: Adult school and noncredit students: ESL, adult secondary, CTE, citizenship
key_variables: Enrollment and hours; CASAS test gains; High school equivalency; Employment and wage outcomes (partial)
legal: WIOA Title II; Education Code 84900 et seq.
c2c_note: Adult schools run by K-12 districts are not in C2C. Many adult learners have no SSN on file.

name: UI base wage records (DE 9C)
population: Workers in UI-covered jobs
key_variables: Quarterly wages by employer; Employer account and industry (NAICS); County of employer
c2c_note: C2C data provider. In May 2026 the Governing Board approved new EDD P20W points, including employer ID and name, and EDD became the first partner to transmit via Snowflake.
notes: No occupation, hours or job title. Excludes self-employed, gig, federal, military and out-of-state work. SB 1054 (Cabaldon, 2026) would add these fields; it was held in Assembly Appropriations.

name: CalJOBS (WIOA participant records)
population: Job seekers and WIOA Title I and III participants at America's Job Centers
key_variables: Services and training received; Credential attainment; Employment and earnings (WIOA performance); Barriers to employment
c2c_note: Part of the LWDA workforce data expansion approved by the C2C board in May 2025 and amended in late 2025.

name: Labor Market Information (OES, QCEW, projections)
population: Employers and occupations statewide
key_variables: Employment and wages by occupation (OES); Employment and wages by industry (QCEW); Occupational projections
c2c_note: Aggregate context. Needed for a program-to-occupation crosswalk.

name: Registered apprenticeship records
population: Registered apprentices and pre-apprentices
key_variables: Apprenticeship program and occupation; Registration, completion and cancellation; Sponsor; Related instruction provider
c2c_note: Included in the LWDA expansion the C2C board approved in May 2025 (described as its largest expansion). Import status should be confirmed.

name: CAAL-Skills workforce program data
population: Participants in 13 workforce programs across 7 state agencies
key_variables: Program participation; Services received; Employment and earnings outcomes; Participant characteristics
c2c_note: CWDB became a C2C data partner in May 2025.

name: Employment Training Panel
population: Incumbent and new workers trained under ETP contracts
key_variables: Employer contract; Training hours; Retention and wage after training
c2c_note: Became a C2C data partner in May 2025.

name: Vocational rehabilitation (WIOA Title IV)
population: People with disabilities receiving VR and pre-employment transition services
key_variables: Eligibility and disability; Services and pre-ETS for students; Employment outcomes
c2c_note: VR participant data reaches CWDB's CAAL-Skills. Direct C2C participation needs confirmation.

name: Corrections education (CDCR, Rising Scholars)
owner: CDCR Office of Correctional Education; CCC Rising Scholars
population: Incarcerated students and people on parole
key_variables: Education program enrollment; Credits and degrees in prison; Release and parole
c2c_note: Not in C2C. CCC records capture Rising Scholars coursework, but release, reentry and employment are not linked.

name: State income tax records
population: State tax filers, including self-employed and CalEITC recipients
key_variables: Self-employment income; CalEITC and Young Child Tax Credit; Household income
c2c_note: Not linked. The only state source that sees self-employment and gig income, and it covers ITIN filers.

name: Out-of-state and federal wages (SWIS, FEDES)
owner: U.S. DOL with state workforce agencies
population: Workers employed in other states, federal civilian jobs and the military
key_variables: Quarterly wages from other states; Federal and military employment
legal: SWIS data sharing agreement (WIOA performance only)
c2c_note: Use is limited to WIOA performance reporting. C2C cannot see Californians who work out of state.

name: Health workforce data
owner: Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI)
population: Licensed health professionals and health workforce program participants
key_variables: License type; Practice location; Education and training; Languages
c2c_note: A model for linking licensure to training, not connected to C2C.

name: DMV identity records
population: Driver license and state ID holders
key_variables: Name and birth date history; Address
c2c_note: Reported as a C2C data partner added in August 2025, likely to improve identity matching. Needs confirmation.

name: Medi-Cal eligibility and claims (MEDS, encounters)
population: About 15 million members, roughly half of California's children
key_variables: Eligibility and aid code; Well-child visits and developmental screening; Dental and vision; Behavioral health services; Managed care plan
legal: Welfare and Institutions Code 14100.2; HIPAA; 42 CFR 431.300
c2c_note: DHCS sits on the C2C Governing Board. Exactly which Medi-Cal points are in P20W needs confirmation.
notes: Developmental screening and well-child visit data could show which children enter school without early supports.

name: School-linked behavioral health fee schedule (CYBHI)
population: Students receiving behavioral health services at or near school
key_variables: Service type and provider; Payer; School/LEA
c2c_note: New since 2024. A potential bridge between school and health records.

name: CalSAWS (CalFresh, CalWORKs, Medi-Cal eligibility)
owner: CalSAWS consortium of 58 counties, overseen by CDSS and DHCS
population: Households applying for or receiving CalFresh, CalWORKs, Stage 1 child care, General Assistance and Medi-Cal
key_variables: Program enrollment and benefit; Household composition; Income and employment; CalWORKs Welfare-to-Work and Stage 1 child care
c2c_note: CDSS is a C2C data provider for selected social services participation indicators.

name: Child welfare (CWS/CMS, CWS-CARES)
owner: CDSS with county child welfare agencies
population: Children with abuse or neglect reports, in foster care, or in extended foster care
key_variables: Referrals and substantiations; Placements and moves; Exits to permanency; Extended foster care (18 to 21)
c2c_note: Foster status reaches C2C through CALPADS. Public dashboards via the California Child Welfare Indicators Project (UC Berkeley).

name: Homelessness data (HMIS, HDIS)
owner: Continuums of Care; CA Interagency Council on Homelessness (HDIS)
population: People served by homeless services
key_variables: Program enrollment; Household type; Exits to housing
c2c_note: Not linked. Schools separately identify McKinney-Vento students, and the two counts rarely meet.

name: Cradle-to-Career Data System (P20W data set and tools)
owner: Office of Cradle-to-Career Data (Government Operations Agency)
population: People matched across 16 data partners (as of July 2026)
key_variables: Linked education, aid, social services and wage records; Query Builder and Student Pathways Dashboard; Expedited and comprehensive data requests; Research library and secure data enclave; Planned transfer outcomes and teacher dashboards
c2c_note: The hub. Partners grew from 8 submitting data in 2023 to 16 in 2026. Early learning and care is the largest remaining hole.

missing_links: caep; cdcr; cdph_birth; fed_fsa; ftb; nsc; swis
notes: Student Pathways Dashboard launched April 22, 2025. 2026-31 Strategic Plan adopted August 2026.

name: Early Childhood Integrated Data System (proposed)
population: Children 0 to 5 across child care, preschool, health, home visiting and early intervention
key_variables: Unduplicated count of children served; Program participation over time; Workforce and supply; Link to C2C at kindergarten entry
c2c_note: Designed to connect to C2C. Not yet authorized or funded. The 2020 Master Plan for Early Learning and Care called for it.

name: CalHHS Data Exchange Framework
population: Health plans, hospitals, providers, counties and social services organizations that sign the Data Sharing Agreement
key_variables: Real-time exchange of health and social services information; Consent management (in development)
legal: Health and Safety Code 130290 (AB 133, 2021); SB 660 (2026); HIPAA
c2c_note: Separate from C2C. Social services organizations began required exchange January 31, 2026. A future bridge for early childhood health data.
